paper_metadata.title: Knowledge Graph Prompting for Multi-Document Question Answering

excerpt: Knowledge Graph Prompting은 여러 문서의 문단·페이지·표를 그래프로 연결하고, LLM 기반 traversal agent가 이미 찾은 근거를 바탕으로 다음 노드를 선택하도록 해 multi-document QA의 검색 문맥을 구성한다.
changes: Preserved paper-focused methods, experiments, limits, figures, and APA references.
Preserved five source figures and removed review-purpose caption language.
uncertainties: Graph construction and traversal quality vary with the document representation and retrieval budget.
leader_resolution: Independent critic findings resolved; source, figures, metadata and rendering validated. Publication tracked separately.
